title: Pulp Fiction
overview: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

title: Schindler's List
overview: In German-occupied Poland, industrialist Oskar Schindler saves more than a thousand Jewish refugees during the Holocaust.

title: Titanic
overview: A fictional love story set against the historical tragedy of the RMS Titanic's ill-fated maiden voyage.

title: The Matrix
overview: A computer hacker learns from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers.

title: Forrest Gump
overview: The presidencies of Kennedy and Johnson, Vietnam, Watergate, and other history unfold through the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75.

title: Fight Club
overview: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into something much more sinister.

title: Gladiator
overview: A former Roman general sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
overview: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom.

title: Finding Nemo
overview: After his son is captured in the Great Barrier Reef, a timid clownfish sets out on a journey to bring him home.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime by facing the Joker, a criminal mastermind who plunges Gotham City into anarchy.

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
overview: When their relationship turns sour, a couple undergoes a medical procedure to have each other erased from their memories.

title: There Will Be Blood
overview: A story of family, religion, hatred, oil and madness, focusing on a turn-of-the-century prospector in the early days of the California oil business.

title: Inception
overview: A thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
overview: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the help of a group of female prisoners.

title: Get Out
overview: A young African-American man visits his white girlfriend's family estate, where he uncovers a disturbing secret.

title: Parasite
overview: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

title: Avengers: Endgame
overview: After the devastating events of Infinity War, the Avengers assemble once more to reverse Thanos's actions and restore balance to the universe.

title: Moonlight
overview: A young man's journey through childhood, adolescence and burgeoning adulthood as he struggles to find his place in the world.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
overview: A middle-aged Chinese immigrant is swept up into an insane adventure where she alone can save the multiverse by exploring other universes.

title: Dune
overview: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man, journeys to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people.

title: The Batman
overview: Batman ventures into Gotham City's underworld when a sadistic killer leaves behind a trail of cryptic clues targeting Gotham's elite.

title: Oppenheimer
overview: The story of American scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.

title: Barbie
overview: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbieland — until they discover the real world.

title: Past Lives
overview: Two childhood friends who are separated after one emigrates from South Korea reunite in New York City two decades later, only to reflect on the life they could have shared.
